sources: https://booking.staylist.app/fisheatingcreek (the site's 'Book Camping' engine: booking/categories and booking/availability for 2026-11-10 to 11-12, read 2026-10-21)

values.note: Operator's booking engine, Tue-Thu 2026-11-10 to 11-12: every RV site (Full Hookup 30/50 Amp, 30/50 ADA, 30 Amp) $43/night; primitive tent $28, waterfront tent $35, tiny cabins $165. Site rate covers four people, $6 per extra person per night. Separate entry fee $5.00 per person (annual pass $75 individual / $125 family); extra axle parking $3. Reservations made more than 90 days ahead 'may be subject to an increased rate'.

fees.source: https://booking.staylist.app/fisheatingcreek/booking/availability (rate_code adr '43.00' on all 29 RV sites offered, '28.00' Primitive Tent, '35.00' Primitive Tent Waterfront), read 2026-10-21 + https://fisheatingcreekoutpost.com/plan-your-stay/camping/ ('Each site rate includes four people ... additional fee of $6 per person, per night') + https://fisheatingcreekoutpost.com/park-rules/ ('entry fees $5.00 per person')

hookups.source: https://fisheatingcreekoutpost.com/plan-your-stay/camping/ ('we rent 52 RV sites, including 48 full-hookup sites with 30 and 50 amp electric, water and sewer'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 120 sites: 52 RV sites near the entrance (48 full hookup; E1-E3 no hookup), many with concrete pads, plus 68 tent sites, many along Fisheating Creek and the swim lake; seven group tent sites. Booking engine site lengths 30-50 ft (one 30-amp site, P4, 30 ft). Pop-ups allowed on primitive sites except waterfront ones.

sites.source: https://fisheatingcreekoutpost.com/plan-your-stay/camping/ ('Select from 120 sites in three distinct areas'; 'we rent 52 RV sites'; 'Choose from 68 tent sites') + https://booking.staylist.app/fisheatingcreek/booking/availability (restrictions.max_length 30-50 on the RV sites), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://fisheatingcreekoutpost.com/about-the-campground/ ('We have two bathhouses with hot water showers, laundry, a well-stocked camp store, and canoe and kayak rentals'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Online through the operator's Staylist page; a one-night non-refundable deposit by credit card. The camping page states a 2-night minimum on waterfront sites in peak season and 3 nights on holiday and special-event weekends for all sites; the booking engine also refused one-night stays on ordinary weekdays (Tue 2026-11-10, Tue 2027-01-12: 'You must book more than 1 night to continue'). Group sites by phone. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 1 pm.

booking.source: https://fisheatingcreekoutpost.com/plan-your-stay/camping/ ('a one-night, non-refundable deposit is required'; 'During peak season, a two-night minimum stay is required for waterfront sites. During holiday and special event weekends, there is a three-night minimum for all campsites') + https://booking.staylist.app/fisheatingcreek/booking/categories (1-night queries for 2026-11-10 and 2027-01-12), read 2026-10-21

note: Private concessionaire (Cape Leisure) campground in Fisheating Creek WMA at Palmdale, run for the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission; drive-in RV and tent sites, canoe/kayak outfitter on Fisheating Creek. Office hours vary with water levels.
summary: Read the operator's pages and its Staylist engine: changed fees 28-43 -> 43/43 (all RV sites $43 for Nov 2026; $28 is the primitive tent rate). Added 50-amp full hookups, 120 sites (52 RV) to 50 ft, showers/laundry/camp store, Staylist url, a 2-night standing minimum (engine) + 3-night holiday minimum. Note trimmed of 'Reservable online'. Not stated: season, pull-throughs, wifi, dump.
flags: Price gate (private): $43/night for an RV site plus a $5.00 per-person entry fee (park-rules page; not clear whether per day or per visit). For two people that is $53 for the first night if the entry fee applies to campers, over the US$50 gate; rates booked more than 90 days ahead 'may be subject to an increased rate'.

Standing minimum: the booking engine refused one-night stays on two ordinary Tuesdays (Nov 2026, Jan 2027), so a passing traveller may need 2 nights; the operator's page only states the waterfront-peak and holiday minimums.

Ownership class: this is a concession on state land (Fisheating Creek WMA), run by Cape Leisure Corporation 'for Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission' (site footer); the entry says private. A human may prefer ownership 'state' (FWC) with a concessionaire note.
